memory_update.text: Core candidates for semiconductor_equipment_and_foundry_capacity are ASML, TSM, AMAT, LRCX, and KLAC because they map directly to EUV lithography, leading-edge foundry capacity, wafer-fab equipment, and process control.

Second-order candidates include TER, ONTO, NVMI, CAMT, ENTG, MKSI, ASX, and AMKR because AI accelerator scale can increase demand for test, metrology, inspection, materials, subsystems, and advanced packaging.

Intel is a hypothesis-level candidate for this node: it is relevant as a major advanced manufacturing investor and prospective foundry alternative, but AI foundry relevance depends on external customer wins, yield, and ramp execution.

GlobalFoundries is a weaker hypothesis-level fit for leading-edge AI accelerator capacity because it focuses on differentiated and specialty nodes rather than the most advanced EUV logic nodes; relevance is more likely through AI data-center supporting semiconductors.

Important non-US or less-accessible companies not fully captured in the US-listed universe include Samsung Electronics, Tokyo Electron, Advantest, SCREEN Holdings, ASM International, BE Semiconductor, Disco, Lasertec, SK hynix, and domestic Chinese equipment suppliers.

Next Layer 2 work should separate this node into subnodes: EUV lithography, etch/deposition, process control/metrology, materials and contamination control, test, advanced packaging, and foundry capacity.

node: Leading-edge foundry capacity, lithography, deposition, etch, metrology, and process control
summary: Expanded US-listed universe for the AI semiconductor equipment and foundry-capacity node. The highest-relevance candidates cluster around leading-edge foundry capacity, EUV lithography, wafer-fab equipment, process control, inspection/metrology, materials/subsystems, and advanced packaging capacity. Key chokepoint logic: if AI accelerator demand remains strong, constraints can propagate upstream from GPUs and HBM into advanced-node wafer capacity, EUV availability, etch/deposition intensity, process-control intensity, and advanced packaging throughput. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
